item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 22/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the next few days. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, showers are expected to ease off gradually and the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week.
